questions.question: What should the frontend include?
questions.answer: Full problem library, unlimited sessions, architecture canvas and Mermaid editors, configurable daily chaos simulations without feature locks, and two-judge AI evaluation with score, verdict, written feedback, and consensus. Dark purple visual direction; billing messaging must be transparent and not gate features.
questions.rationale: These product capabilities and visual requirements were specified in the request.

Dark purple visual direction; billing messaging must be transparent and not gate features.

questions.question: Which backend framework should be used?
What should the application API support?
questions.answer: Persist problems and practice data; provide the application APIs and invoke two independent AI judges whose results produce a 0-100 score, pass/borderline/fail verdict, written feedback, and consensus. Keep features unlocked. Make provider integrations optional and support running the complete local app in one Docker container.
questions.rationale: The requested application needs persistence and API support for its learning and evaluation workflows, while keeping provider integrations optional.
questions.recommendedChoice: Persist problems and practice data; provide the application APIs and invoke two independent AI judges whose results produce a 0-100 score, pass/borderline/fail verdict, written feedback, and consensus. Keep features unlocked. Make provider integrations optional and support running the complete local app in one Docker container.

questions.question: Which data stores does the application need?
questions.rationale: The application needs persistent learning and evaluation data, and PostgreSQL was requested if a database is needed. The single-container local-run requirement will need a deliberate packaging tradeoff; managed PostgreSQL can remain an optional deployment dependency.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Persist application accounts, problems, sessions, and evaluations.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The application does not need persistent storage.

questions.question: Do users need to sign in for application features?
questions.rationale: The request requires all capabilities to be unlocked and does not specify user accounts or sign-in. Provider credentials for optional AI or billing integrations are separate from application sign-in.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users sign in to use application features.

options.label: No
options.description: Application features are available without sign-in.
